summary: Loma Negra, the Argentine cement producer listed on NYSE and BYMA, furnished a Form 6-K containing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release rather than any transactional event. Net sales were Ps. 270,107 million (US$177 million), down 3.2% year over year; consolidated Adjusted EBITDA was Ps. 54,189 million (US$42 million), a 6.7% peso decline but 16.2% higher in dollars, with a 20.1% margin. Net profit reached Ps. 14,482 million versus a prior-year loss. Net debt fell to Ps. 220,486 million, or 1.00x LTM EBITDA, and the company issued a US$150 million bond post-quarter to refinance maturities. No deal terms, advisors or board recommendations apply.
